notes: I replaced the single fixed power law `-(|x|^5.85)` with a log-log interpolation table built from the clean large-|x| points in E14/E16, separately for positive and negative sides. The old exponent was too high at small |x| (e.g. 3, 4, 5) and the negative side has a genuinely different curve (|f(-x)| > |f(x)| by ~1.15–1.19), which the old model wrongly forced to be identical.
